title: scrnavigator-nf pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline parameter schema for the scrnavigator-nf Nextflow workflow.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Parameters that control the pipeline inputs and outputs.

input.description: Path to the input samplesheet CSV file.

outdir.description: Directory to place output files in.

run_options.title: Run options
run_options.description: Parameters that control the pipeline execution and flow.

no_analysis.description: Only run up to integration, don't perform pseudobulking, DE, or FEA.

cohort_id.description: Name for the integrated cohort. Default: 'cohort'.

resolutions.description: Comma-separated list of clustering resolutions (floats or integers) to use for QC. Defaults to values from 0.6 to 2.4 in steps of 0.2.

integrated_resolution.description: Final clustering resolution (float or integer) for the integrated dataset.

cluster_method.description: Method to use for clustering. Either 'louvain' or 'leiden' (default: 'louvain').

species.description: The species that the samples belong to.

no_mt.description: Specifies that annotation of mitochondrial gene percentages should be skipped.

mt_gene_list.description: Path to a text file containing known mitochondrial genes in the species. Not required when --species is either 'human' or 'mouse'.

ens_db_rds.description: Path to an RDS file containing an AnnotationDb object for the Ensembl database (e.g. EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86). Required for species other than 'human' or 'mouse'.

s_genes.description: Path to a text file containing S gene IDs for cell cycle annotation. Not required when --species is 'human'.

g2m_genes.description: Path to a text file containing G2M gene IDs for cell cycle annotation. Not required when --species is 'human'.

annotation_db.description: Path to an RDS file containing a suitable reference dataset for cell type annotation with SingleR. When --species is 'human', the Human Primary Cell Atlas (HPCA) data from the celldex package will be used by default. As per the SingleR documentaiton, this must be 'a numeric matrix of single-cell expression values where rows are genes and columns are cells. Alternatively, a SummarizedExperiment object containing such a matrix'
